notes: ἔχω ἀνάγκην is split under rule 2 because the ASV writes two English words, *must* and *needs*; reading it as one collapsed light-verb unit under rule 73 remains defensible, rule 73 being scoped to a pair the ASV collapses into a single English verb.
παραιτεῖσθαι → *to make excuse* heads on *excuse* under rule 91, the same verse's παρῃτημένον → *excused* showing which word the lexeme is spent on.
